title: Jula Finding
description: Schema for the finding object within an evidence file. Contains raw infrastructure state data extracted from a provider.

evidence_id.description: Evidence Request List identifier that triggered this extraction.

source_id.description: Resource source identifier (e.g., GCP project ID, AWS account ID).

raw_data.description: Raw extraction payload. For API-based extractions, this is the JSON array of resource objects. For file-based extractions, this is the raw file content.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this execution run.
